---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

The relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating is shown in Figure @fig-runtime-rating. This plot allows us to examine whether longer or shorter films tend to receive higher ratings.

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Film Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")
plt.show()
```

### Mean IMDb Rating by Decade

::: {#394949d5 .cell execution_count=2}

``` {.python .cell-code}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
